sourceChecks.title: ASALE, Crónica de la lengua española 2021, “Novedades sobre el voseo”
sourceChecks.finding: Describes Guatemala as a voseo zone and a context-sensitive vos/tú/usted system; it does not establish equivalence with Russian ты/вы.

sourceChecks.title: University of Kansas, Между нами 1.4: ты и вы
sourceChecks.finding: Explains informal ты versus formal/plural вы and context-sensitive selection; does not compare Guatemalan vos.

sourceChecks.title: Instituto Cervantes, Catálogo de voces hispánicas: Guatemala, Antigua
sourceChecks.finding: Describes Guatemalan voseo/tuteo/ustedes practices and contextual variation; not Russian equivalence.

sourceChecks.title: University of Kansas, Между нами 1.4: ты и вы
sourceChecks.finding: Explains informal ты and plural/formal вы with contextual choice; does not establish equivalence to Guatemalan voseo.
